long_biography.plain_text:
At Iliane, Régis Bruteul took responsibility for finance while Eddy Le Nenes led operations and sales. Their arrangement followed the combination of Bruteul's MVI with a Nantes technology-services company that offered hosting, cloud infrastructure and business software. MVI brought an established systems-integration practice and cash reserves that the partners intended to use for acquisitions.

Bruteul had built MVI in Brest and also spent many years chairing the Séquence association of IT integrators. After OCI took control of Iliane, his continuing corporate role centred on RBEL. The holding company remains active with financial assets and interests in property companies.
